probe.text_sample: Home | Ray Skip to content Projects Collaboration Research Press Contact About Us More than a building. It’s a place. At RAY, we create branded residential buildings where art and design are a part of the everyday. Each building brings together thoughtfully considered architecture, a curated fine art collection, and an intentional calendar of programming. This holistic approach ensures every experience reflects the same high level of care and design. As the creative and capital partner to like-minded developers, we bring to life design-forward residences that connect people to their neighbors, their neighborhoods, and to culture at large. Our buildings are designed to help residents feel at home not only in their lived spaces, but in the neighborhoods that surround them too. We host public and private programming to create opportunities for neighbors to naturally meet and connect, and partner with local businesses to ensure our events reflect and support the communities we’re a part of.
